meta.requirement: Explore Springvale (20%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Forged in Fire
start.text:
''Near the edge of Springvale, past the last row of farmhouses, an old man is seated beside a low fence with a pickaxe resting in his lap. He is staring at the ground in front of him, worry and stubbornness mixed on his weathered face.''

''He is thin. Frail-looking. But his grip on the pickaxe handle is steady.''

Gregory: ''glances up'' Oh. Traveller. Don't mind me. Just thinking about rocks.

what_kind_of_rocks.text:
Gregory: ''taps the pickaxe against his knee'' Crystal Chunk. ''says it carefully, like a name he has been turning over for years'' Rare ore. Hard, clear, catches the light wrong. Most folk don't bother with it. Takes too long to chip out.

''He looks toward the treeline north of the village.''

Gregory: But I'm not looking for most ores.

y_crys_chunk.text:
Gregory: ''a small, private smile''

Gregory: Got a friend in Mondstadt. Blacksmith named Emre. He's been wanting a proper batch for years, for something called the reforge oven. Needs the right crystal to burn properly, apparently. ''quietly'' I told him I'd find some. That was... a while ago.

''He shifts on the fence.''

Gregory: They say there's an abandoned mine up in Stormbearer Mountains. Old seam. Crystal Chunk runs thick in there, or so I'm told. My legs don't carry me that far anymore, and I haven't been able to get enough on my own.

choices.label: I can gather some. What do you need?

can_gather.text:
Gregory: ''looks at you properly now, weighing something''

Gregory: Ten Crystal Chunks. You'll know them when you see them, pale and clear, sort of wrong in the light. ''pauses'' If you know how to mine, I've heard Stormbearer Mountains is where folk find them. Abandoned section, deep in the rock. Might be a ways off for you yet.

''He settles back against the fence.''

Gregory: Bring me ten when you have them. I'll be here in Springvale.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 10 Crystal Chunks and bring them to Gregory in Springvale

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Bring Gregory the Crystal Chunks

u_bring.text:
''Gregory is in the same spot, pickaxe across his knees. He looks up as you approach.''

Gregory: Back already.

not_yet.text:
Gregory: ''nods, unhurried''

Gregory: No rush. ''rests the pickaxe on the fence'' I'll be here. Stormbearer can wait until you're ready for it.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 10 Crystal Chunks and bring them to Gregory in Springvale

brought_10.text:
''You hold out the crystals. Gregory sets the pickaxe down and takes them one by one, turning each over slowly between his thumb and forefinger.''

Gregory: ''quietly'' Yes. Yes, that's them. ''taps a facet with his nail, listening to the tone'' Good ones, too. ''he looks up'' You found a proper seam.

choices.label: Took a while, but I got them

took_a_while.text:
Gregory: ''nods, satisfied''

''He wraps the crystals carefully in a worn cloth, handling them with more gentleness than he gave the fence post.''

Gregory: These need to get to my friend in Mondstadt. Emre. He runs the forge near the market district. ''pauses'' I'd bring them myself, but my legs have their own opinions about Mondstadt these days. Too many stairs. Too much cobblestone.

''He looks at you sideways.''

Gregory: You look like someone who walks a lot.

choices.label: I know Emre. I can bring them to him

ik_emre.text:
''Gregory is still for a moment. Then he hands the wrapped bundle back to you, slowly, like something he has been carrying a long time.''

Gregory: ''quietly'' Tell him old Gregory still comes good. He'll know what that means.

''He picks up the pickaxe. Then sets it down again.''

Gregory: He's been waiting on a proper batch to start the reforge oven up properly. Temperamental thing, apparently. Needs the right crystals or it just smoulders.

''He waves you off, not unkindly.''

Gregory: Go on. I'll keep an eye on Springvale.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring the Crystal Chunks to Emre at his forge in Mondstadt

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and then click on Deliver Crystal Chunks to Emre

go_to_emre.text:
''Emre is at his bench, turning a piece of metal stock over in his hands with the studied expression of someone who has already decided what it's going to become. He looks up as you approach.''

Emre: ''sets the stock down'' Something I can do for you?

choices.label: Gregory asked me to bring you something

gregory_asked.text:
''Emre goes still.''

Emre: Gregory.

''It isn't a question. He comes around the bench and takes the wrapped cloth carefully, already unwrapping it before he gets back to his side of the forge.''

Emre: ''turning a crystal in the light'' Ten. ''exhales once, something between a laugh and relief'' The old man actually came through.

''He sets them on the bench and runs a hand across them like he's checking for flaws, but he's not really looking for flaws.''

Emre: How is he?

choices.label: Still sitting by the fence in Springvale with that pickaxe

still_sitting.text:
''Emre shakes his head, but there is something fond in it.''

Emre: Of course he is. ''looks at the crystals'' He told me three years ago he'd find me a proper batch for the reforge oven. I stopped believing him after year two. ''quietly'' I should not have done that.

''He begins sorting the crystals into a small metal tray beside the forge.''

Emre: The oven needs the crystal to hold heat properly. Without a good batch it just smoulders. Ruins the metal. I've been doing plain work while I waited.

''He looks up.''

Emre: Tell him the forge is running.

choices.label: "He said to tell you old Gregory still comes good."

oven_running.title: Oven Running
oven_running.text:
''Emre is quiet. He turns to the oven and opens the grate, checking the coals.''

Emre: ''to himself'' Old Gregory still comes good. ''a short sound, almost a laugh''

''He feeds the crystals into the fire chamber one by one, carefully, and something in the oven changes. The colour of the heat shifts slightly, deepens.''

Emre: ''without looking up'' That's what I've been waiting for.

''He closes the grate and straightens.''

Emre: The reforge oven is yours to use, traveller. Any weapon you want reshaped, bring it here. ''touches the bench'' And if you see Gregory in Springvale again... tell the old man thank you.

''The forge has a different quality now. Something older in it. Something ready.''
